subject: general
question:
What will come in the place of the question mark (?) in the following equation, if ‘+’ and ‘−’ are interchanged and ‘×’ and ‘÷’ are interchanged?

 34 - 7 div 6 + 270 times 9 = ?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Interchange signs: (− → +), (÷ → ×), (+ → −), (× → ÷).

New expression: 34 + 7 × 6 − 270 ÷ 9

Using BODMAS: 34 + 42 − 30

Final value: 76 − 30 = 46

**∴ The correct answer is 46.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

Given equation: 34 − 7 ÷ 6 + 270 × 9 = ?

Rule: Interchange (+) with (−) and (×) with (÷).

⇒ Modified equation: 34 + 7 × 6 − 270 ÷ 9

⇒ 34 + 7 × 6 − (270 ÷ 9)

⇒ 34 + 7 × 6 − 30

⇒ 34 + (7 × 6) − 30

⇒ 34 + 42 − 30

⇒ 76 − 30

⇒ 46

**∴ The correct answer is 46.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

BODMAS Rule

Simplification always follows the sequence: Brackets, Orders, Division, Multiplication, Addition, and then Subtraction.

Sign Interchange Method

In logical reasoning, ensure all pairs of signs are swapped simultaneously before initiating the calculation to prevent BODMAS errors.</p
